scripts.test:create-stati: npm run build -w packages/create-stati && cd examples && node ../packages/create-stati/dist/index.js test-scaffolded
scripts.test:create-stati:images: npm run build && cd examples && node ../packages/create-stati/dist/index.js test-images --template=blog --styling=css --images --no-install --no-git --no-agent-skill && cd test-images && node ../../packages/cli/dist/cli.js build
scripts.typecheck:ci: echo 'No TypeScript files to check in examples'
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/images && npm run build -w packages/cli && npm run build -w packages/create-stati
scripts.test:blank:build: npm run build && cd examples/blank && npm run build
scripts.test:blank:dev: npm run build && cd examples/blank && npm run dev
scripts.test:blank:preview: npm run build && cd examples/blank && npm run preview
scripts.test:blank:full: npm run test:blank:clean && npm run test:blank:build && echo Build completed successfully!
scripts.test:blog:build: npm run build && cd examples/blog && npm run build
scripts.test:blog:dev: npm run build && cd examples/blog && npm run dev
scripts.test:blog:preview: npm run build && cd examples/blog && npm run preview
scripts.test:blog:full: npm run test:blog:clean && npm run test:blog:build && echo Build completed successfully!
scripts.test:docs:build: npm run build && cd examples/docs && npm run build
scripts.test:docs:dev: npm run build && cd examples/docs && npm run dev
scripts.test:docs:preview: npm run build && cd examples/docs && npm run preview
scripts.test:docs:full: npm run test:docs:clean && npm run test:docs:build && echo Build completed successfully!
scripts.test:ci: npm run build && npm run lint:ci && npm run typecheck:ci && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:dev-leak
scripts.changeset:version: changeset version && echo Note: Pathspec warnings above are normal when processing changesets
scripts.release:emergency: npm run build && npm run changeset:version && npm run changeset:publish && git push --follow-tags
